FulfillmentType.description: FulfillmentType stores the type of fullfillment options system has. ServiceLevel.title: ServiceLevel
ServiceLevel.description: ServiceLevel stores the LEVEL of service against a FulfillmentType. Level here can be defined as quality/fastness of a service. For example standard delivery and express delivery, both are the home deliveries but differ in how quickly the items can be delivered. There might be higher cost/fees associated with quicker service
